think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether the knob has one or more sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that change the meaning qualitatively (disable/auto/unlimited) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) If such sentinel values exist and are documented as changing the feature’s mode, classify as a special knob and record those value(s). Otherwise, classify as non-special.
